purpose: Teach: 激突/宝庫/博し/中澤/中尾/江原/大原/大川

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、車両激突の現場検証を、警察、慎重におこなわれますね
lines.en: In this case, the police are conducting a careful on-site investigation of the vehicle collision, aren't they.
lines.style: Measured, slightly formal. Pause weight on 'case.' Soft, observational tone—not questioning, affirming. Even pacing, as if reading a report aloud to oneself.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、押収物の宝庫、つまり保管庫の管理も徹底されますね
lines.en: And the police are also being thorough about managing the evidence storage, I imagine.
lines.style: Professional and collaborative. Steady, affirming tone. Slight nod in the voice. Even tempo, building on what was just said. Practical, not flowery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者が人気を博した過去を、警察、慎重に扱われますね
lines.en: The suspect's past celebrity status is something the police are handling with particular care in this case, I'd think.
lines.style: Quiet, careful. Slight weightiness on 'celebrity'—acknowledging the complication. Thoughtful pause. The tone of someone working through a problem aloud, not pronouncing judgment.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、参考人中澤氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: The police will be interviewing the witness Nakasawa carefully to gather their account, I expect.
lines.style: Even, professional. Light confirmation in the phrasing. Steady pacing. The tone of someone following procedure step by step, methodical and reassuring.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、目撃者中尾氏の供述を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: The police are documenting the eyewitness Nakao's statement thoroughly, as I understand it.
lines.style: Deliberate, observational. Weight on 'documenting'—the precision matters. Slow enough to let each point land. The rhythm of someone taking careful notes.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者江原氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: And consideration is being shown to the victim Ehara's family throughout this process, naturally.
lines.style: Warm undertone beneath the formality. Gentle firmness on 'family'—this matters. Slower tempo. The voice of someone who holds both procedure and compassion at once.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、心理士大原様にご助言を仰がれますね
lines.en: The police are also seeking guidance from the psychologist Ohara on this matter, I imagine.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly deferential. Soft pause before 'psychologist'—recognizing expertise. Measured pace. The tone of someone consulting the right person at the right stage.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、検事の大川様と公判前協議もされますね
lines.en: And the prosecutor Okawa is conducting pre-trial conferences with the police as well, I believe.
lines.style: Close, almost confidential. A touch lighter than previous lines—building toward coordination. Steady but slightly quicker pace. The sense of pieces coming together, understood between professionals.
